people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

translations.web: Balak again sent princes, more, and more honorable than they.
translations.bsb: Then Balak sent other princes, more numerous and more distinguished than the first messengers.
translations.kjv: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable
translations.asv: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honorable than they.
